messages:
carla: Quick update: Lumina EAP NDA fully executed this morning. Need to confirm infra access & bench plan before we hand over images.
raj: Thanks — infra can carve a dedicated test rack in us-east-1. ETA for hostname & creds: today COB.
carla: Lumina asked for two things up front: (A) a minimal reproducible perf script, (B) telemetry that reports per-token latency + GPU mem peaks to their S3.
ev an: I'll put a small script in infra/benchmarks/lumina/run_minimal.sh. Usage: `./run_minimal.sh --model redwood-4b --seq 1024 --iters 25 --save results.json`
ev an: sample output snippet:
```
WARMUP 2
avg 28ms/token
p95 54ms
gpu_peak 9.6GB
```
lumina-eng (partner): Confirm S3 bucket will be `s3://lumina-eap-telemetry`. We will request role-based read for your upload role. Telemetry schema OK as discussed.
carla: Important: privacy boundary — no customer content leaves the VPC. Only aggregated telemetry + anonymized token latency traces allowed.
legal-bot: Clause 4.2 (data handling) verified: Lumina accepts aggregated telemetry only. Please keep access logs for 90 days.
raj: Operational notes: pin CUDA driver to 525.85, use MAX_BATCH=6 and MAX_SEQ=1024 for stability on the preview boards. We'll expose metrics at /metrics and a structured JSON sink to S3.
ev an: Adding a tracing toggle in the deployment manifest: `REDWOOD_TRACING=lumina-eap` and `TRACE_SINK=s3://lumina-eap-telemetry`. Also will generate signed URLs for partner retrieval.
carla: Perf target ask from product: Lumina variant should be within 10% of our reference latency on comparable sequence lengths. If regression >15%, automatic fallback to quantized-4b is allowed per the preview agreement.
lumina-eng (partner): Acknowledged. We'll run your baseline and push our microbench results back to the repo under /benchmarks/lumina/<ts>.
ci-bot: bench job queued: lumina-run-8821 on host lumina-use1-03 (started).
ev an: I kicked off a quick smoke run just now, here's the job summary: avg 31ms/token, p95 62ms, peak mem 10.2GB. Uploading results to /benchmarks/lumina/1818769012/smoke.json
raj: Noted. We'll monitor OOMs and keep conservative OMP threads. Also adding restart-backoff policy of 30s for early instability.
carla: Timeline recap: infra creds today, minimal script landed by @evan today, full bench run by @raj tomorrow, telemetry policy + access doc by legal/ops by EOD Monday. Any blockers?
ev an: none from ENG side, will post PR in a few hours.
lumina-eng (partner): No blockers. Thanks everyone.
carla: Great — I'll draft the brief for marketing/legal: "Lumina limited early access — performance collaboration" and circulate for signoff. :sparkles:
